comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening stop versus wind back a screw-type brake piston and fit two pads.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve rotary tool seating, but the candidate counterholds a screw while tightening a concentric jam nut; the brake task presses and rotates a two-pin tool, then performs constrained pad insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained stop angle and repeated articulation; the brake task requires piston retraction followed by one or both pads seated within millimetre and angular tolerances.
comparison.reason: Shared threaded-tool manipulation is generic; only the candidate tests preserving an adjustment against locknut reaction and verifying that stop through subsequent cycles.
